meta.name: A&A Strategic Plan 2030
meta.about: How HAX meets the College of Arts and Architecture's Strategic Plan 2030, generated from strategic-plans.json (a snapshot of https://arts.psu.edu/about/aa-strategic-plan-2030 read 2026-11-11). Only the sub-objectives HAX meets are shown; each goal's link to a Penn State priority is A&A's own.

aaplan.desc: The College of Arts and Architecture's Strategic Plan 2030 (2026–2030), limited to what HAX meets: 14 sub-objectives across its five goals. Sub-objectives HAX doesn't meet are left out. A snapshot read 2026-11-11.

ag_g1.desc: Strengthen trust, connection and belonging across people, partnerships and programs. A&A aligns it to Penn State's Transform Internal Operations.

ag_g2.desc: Enrich campus, community and civic life across Pennsylvania and beyond. A&A aligns it to Penn State's Increasing Land-Grant Impact.

ag_g3.desc: Develop skills, imagination and agency. A&A aligns it to Penn State's Enhancing Student Success.

ag_g4.desc: Advance discovery, insight, influence and impact. A&A aligns it to Penn State's Growing (Inter)disciplinary Research Excellence.

ag_g5.desc: Every student, faculty member and staff member has the support, access and opportunities to thrive. A&A aligns it to Penn State's Fostering Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging.

as_1a.desc: Reimagine shared physical spaces and systems to encourage collaboration. HAX Lab is a physical space for cross-discipline work like the Flourish Hub, student internships and collaborations. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_1b.desc: Build cross-disciplinary collaboration into curricula, research and creative practice. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_1c.desc: Use collaboration to reduce administrative burden rather than add to workloads. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_2b.desc: Expand artist residencies and student experiential opportunities. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_2c.desc: Embed human-centered design principles in courses, performances and creative practice. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_2d.desc: Strengthen A&A's visibility and partnerships at state, national and global levels. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_3a.desc: Expose students to diverse career pathways through arts- and design-integrated experiential learning. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_3b.desc: Build ethical AI literacy and future-ready skills into curricular and co-curricular experiences. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_3c.desc: Expand A&A's role in General Education so all students can explore creativity and emerging technologies. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_3d.desc: Develop new degrees, minors, certificates and hybrid learning models that match demand and workforce needs. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_4a.desc: Build cross-campus partnerships that raise the visibility and impact of arts and design. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_4b.desc: Elevate recognition of A&A's creative activity, research and scholarship. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_4c.desc: Lead University-wide human-centered use of AI in creative practice and research. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

as_5b.desc: Reduce or remove affordability and access barriers to participation. (Paraphrased; see the plan for its words.)

tours.message: 14 sub-objectives across five goals, each aligned by A&A to a Penn State priority.

scenes.caption: A&A's five goals, each aligned to a Penn State priority.
Goal 1: Build a culture of collaboration.
Goal 2: Amplify our responsibility as a cultural bridge.
Goal 3: Empower learners to build the future.
Goal 4: Champion the arts and design as transformative forms of research and practice.
Goal 5: Cultivate an equitable community for all.
